title: crepidium asperum
intro: Crepidium asperum, commonly known as the Rough Spider Orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Crepidium asperum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Crepidium asperum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
